summary: Iteration 23 — Re-verified iteration_22 security follow-up fixes. Full backend regression pytest suite now 38/38 pass (0 skip, 0 xfail, 0 error) covering test_order_cleanup.py (2), test_create_order_ip.py (5), test_order_tax_settings.py (8), test_cleanup_iteration_21.py (13), test_order_security.py (9). New test test_blocklist_persist_across_restart.py passes: admin blocks 9.9.9.x → in-memory 429 → sudo supervisorctl restart backend → sleep 5 → same IP STILL returns 429 (restored from db.site_settings.blocklist) → 'Blocklist restored: 1 IPs, 0 emails' present in supervisor log → cleanup via DELETE /api/blocklist/ip. Real-order smoke: POST /api/orders/create with YT Premium payload (product_id=a82b37ff-…, variation_id=var-1769608319597, total_amount=180) returned 200, persisted with total_amount=180.0, and was found in GET /api/orders. Fraudulent-order purge verified: 0 rows with items.variation='5 Diamonds 💎' AND total<100, 0 rows with id='8a8f69ab-0e9e-4c25-ad59-029e01a370e2', 0 orders with the 5-Diamond variation at all. Health returned 200 in 176ms; GET /api/settings has both tax_percentage and service_charge; PUT /api/settings tax=150 as admin correctly returns 422 (Pydantic le<=100). Unauth PUT /api/settings returns 403. conftest.py per-test X-Forwarded-For injection is still in place and preventing rate-limiter cross-contamination.

minor.issue: Pre-existing (flagged in iter21/22): 'invalid_grant: Invalid JWT Signature' on every successful order sync. Not caused by this fix. Recommend rotating GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/orders.py is still 1261 lines. Recommend splitting into orders_create.py + orders_admin.py + orders_status.py + orders_blocklist.py (still exceeds the 700-line guideline).

check_rate_limit still falls back to key='unknown' when X-Forwarded-For is missing. Legit customers behind a proxy chain that strips the header would share one 3-order counter globally. Consider hashing email+useragent as a fallback bucket instead.
Rate-limit key is (ip,) only. Attackers rotating cheap proxies can still burst orders. Add a secondary email-level counter for defence-in-depth.
restore_blocklist route (/api/blocklist/restore) is still present but now redundant with the auto-restore on startup. Consider removing or documenting it as a manual admin escape hatch.
Duplicate stock-decrement logic in complete_order + update_order_status. Extract into _decrement_variation_stock(item) helper.
The 5%/Rs 2 tolerance silently uses server_final over client total. A logged INFO diff (e.g. 'server=203 client=202 accepted within Rs 2 floor') would help future forensic investigation of drifts.
